statistics_definitions.mesh_object_count: Number of MESH objects in the Dragon collection after the build script finishes.
statistics_definitions.polygon_count: Sum of faces of the evaluated (post-modifier) mesh of every Dragon mesh object.
statistics_definitions.triangle_count: Sum of loop triangles of the evaluated meshes (what a game engine would receive).
statistics_definitions.vertex_count: Sum of vertices of the evaluated meshes.
statistics_definitions.material_count: Number of distinct materials referenced by Dragon mesh objects.
statistics_definitions.dimensions: World-space axis-aligned bounding box of all evaluated Dragon vertices.
statistics_definitions.file_size: Size in bytes of the saved .blend (uncompressed save).
statistics_definitions.script_time: Wall-clock seconds of the build script measured inside Blender with time.perf_counter().
statistics_definitions.shells: Connected mesh components per object (high values = assembled, non-unified parts).
statistics_definitions.non_manifold_edges: Edges not shared by exactly two faces (open borders or intersecting/coincident geometry).
statistics_definitions.buried_surface_estimate: Share of faces/area whose point 1.5 mm outside the face lies inside another closed shell of the model (ray-parity test). Measures hidden, wasted geometry from interpenetrating parts. Estimate: open shells make parity approximate.
